name: Score and enrich local leads from Google Maps with API.SH

parameters.content:
## Find, enrich and score local leads from Google Maps

### Who is this for
Agencies, SaaS sales teams and freelancers who sell to local businesses (dentists, gyms, roofers, restaurants…) and want a fresh, qualified list every week instead of copying Google Maps by hand.

### What it does
Every Monday it runs each search in your **Searches** tab (for example *dentist* in *Austin, TX*) on Google Maps with the **API.SH** node, keeps open businesses that meet your rating and review bar, and skips anyone already in your **Leads** tab. For each new business with a website it looks up the emails, phone numbers and social profiles published on that site, scores the lead out of 100 and saves it. Hot leads go to Slack for outreach, and you get an email digest of the run. Failed searches are logged to an **Errors** tab and posted to Slack, and the run carries on.

### Setup
1. Install the verified **API.SH** node (nodes panel → search "API.SH"), create a free account at [api.sh](https://api.sh/integrations/n8n?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=integration&utm_campaign=template-local-leads-google-maps-enrich-score) and add your API key as an **API.SH** credential.
2. Create a Google Sheet with three tabs: **Searches** (headers `query`, `city`, `active`), **Leads** and **Errors** (both can start empty: the workflow writes the headers).
3. Open **Settings**: paste the sheet URL, your Slack channel and the digest email, and adjust the quality bar.
4. Connect Google Sheets, Slack and Gmail, then run it once by hand to check the output.

### How to customise
- Change the scoring weights in **Score leads** (for example, favour businesses *without* online booking if you sell booking software).
- Raise `pages_per_search` for dense cities; lower `max_new_leads_per_run` to control spend.
- Swap **Post hot leads** for your CRM node (HubSpot, Pipedrive) to create contacts directly.

## 1. Settings and searches
Edit **Settings** once. Each active row of the Searches tab becomes one search per results page.

## 2. Search Google Maps
One API.SH call per results page, a short pause between calls. A failed page is marked and the loop continues.

## 3. Qualify and dedupe
Keeps open places above your rating and review bar, then removes businesses already in the Leads tab (by place and website).

## Error path
Failed search pages are written to the Errors tab and posted once to Slack.

## 4. Enrich from the website
For leads with a website, API.SH reads the site for emails, phones and social profiles. Own-domain and named addresses rank first.

## 5. Score, save and hand off
Score out of 100 with reasons, append to the Leads tab, post hot leads to Slack and email the digest.

schema.displayName: Q (e.g. coffee near times square)
Lat (Centre the search on this point (with lng), like the map viewport.)
Lng (Longitude of the centre point.)
Zoom (With lat/lng, the map zoom 3-21 (default 14); lower is a wider area.)
Page (Page number. Pass next_page from the previous response; next_page is null on the)
Limit (Places to return (default 20, max 200; each 20 is one more page).)
Bbox (Search inside a bounding box: south,west,north,east (degrees). Results outside t)
Ne (With sw, the box's north-east corner lat,lng (instead of bbox).)
Sw (With ne, the box's south-west corner lat,lng.)
Radius (With lat/lng: only places within this many metres (10-100000); sets the zoom to )
Query (Same as q.)
Subtypes (Keep only businesses with one of these categories (comma-separated, as in subtyp)
Verified (true: only businesses claimed by their owner; false: only unclaimed ones.)
Business Status (Keep only these statuses (comma-separated): OPEN, CLOSED_TEMPORARILY, CLOSED.)
Extract Emails And Contacts (true: also read the business website (home page and its contact page) for emails)
Language (Language (same as hl, default en).)
Region (Country (same as gl, default us).)
Min Rating (Only places rated at least this (1-5, e.g. 4.5).)
Open Now (true: only places open now.)
